oneLine: Motilal Oswal Alternates sells a stake in Molbio Diagnostics via block deal for Rs 306 cr.

sources.title: Motilal Oswal Alternates sells over 2% stake in Molbio Diagnostics for ₹306 cr

synopsis: Motilal Oswal Alternates, through its fund Business Excellence Trust III, sold a little over 2 per cent stake in Goa-based Molbio Diagnostics for ₹306 crore through open market transactions. The fund offloaded 23.28 lakh shares at an average price of ₹1,315.01 apiece. HDFC Mutual Fund bought 23 lakh shares, amounting to a 2 per cent stake, for ₹302.45 crore. Business Excellence Trust III previously held an 11.52 per cent stake in Molbio as of August 2026. Separately, Gian Parkash Aggarwal sold a 2.71 per cent stake in Innova Captab for ₹167 crore, while SBI Mutual Fund acquired a 1.45 per cent stake in the same company for ₹90 crore.
